story_log.title: Spurs eliminate Timberwolves, advance to WCF to face Thunder
story_log.development: Spurs won Game 6 in Minnesota 139-109 to close out series 4-2. Stephon Castle exploded for 32-11-6 with 5 threes. Anthony Edwards dapped up Spurs bench with 8 minutes left. Julius Randle and Rudy Gobert combined for 3 points on 1-12 FG. Spurs face defending champs OKC in WCF.

story_log.title: Pistons force Game 7 behind BBall Paul, Cade, and Duren's dominance
story_log.development: Detroit won Game 6 in Cleveland 115-94 to force Game 7 back in Detroit. Paul Reed was everywhere, Jalen Duren played with force, Cade Cunningham orchestrated. Donovan Mitchell held scoreless in Game 6 struggles. Winner goes to Eastern Conference Finals vs Knicks.

story_log.title: Mets' Clay Holmes fractures fibula on 111 mph comebacker, out long time
story_log.development: Holmes fractured fibula after taking 111 mph comebacker to leg in Subway Series. Initially stayed in game. Team says he'll be out 'a long time.' Holmes leads Mets in WAR this season.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber reaches 20 homers before Fernando Tatis Jr. hits ONE
story_log.development: Schwarber became first player to 20 homers this season. Tatis still has zero. Schwarber can't explain why he's on this tear. Internet notices the absurdity.

story_log.title: 2026 NFL schedule criticized for historic rest disparity
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analysis published full rest disparity breakdown: 110 games with rest advantage (most ever), Chargers get -24 net rest (worst since 2013), Bears get +15 (2nd-best since 1990). League prioritized money over competitive fairness.

story_log.title: Golden Knights stripped of 2nd-round pick, Tortorella fined $100k for media violations
story_log.development: NHL stripped Vegas of second-round pick and fined coach John Tortorella $100k for 'flagrant violations' of Stanley Cup playoff media regulations. Unprecedented penalty.

story_log.title: Charles Woodson Jr. commits to Michigan, following father's legendary footsteps
story_log.development: Four-star DB Charles Woodson Jr. committed to Michigan, same school where his father won Heisman Trophy. Like father, like son.

story_log.title: Suspect arrested in shooting of Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy
story_log.development: 20-year-old man arrested in connection with shooting of Missouri star Ahmad Hardy at outdoor concert in Mississippi. Hardy remains in stable condition.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson becomes first player in WNBA history with multiple 45-point games
story_log.development: Wilson dropped 45+ points for second time in career, only player in WNBA history to do it multiple times. Aces beat Sun.

story_log.title: Mason Miller pitching like the best closer in baseball
story_log.development: Miller threw 34-pitch, 4-out save with 4 strikeouts. Now has 21 IP, 0.86 ERA, 44 SO, 14 SV, leads all relievers in K/9 (18.86). A's have an absolute weapon.

story_log.title: Wolves traded more picks for Rudy Gobert than he scored in Games 5 and 6 combined
story_log.development: StatMuse tweet roasting Gobert: Wolves gave up more draft picks for him than his combined point total in final two games of series. Gobert had 0 points in Game 6.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle becomes youngest player ever with 30-10-5-5 playoff game
story_log.development: Castle at 21 became youngest player in NBA history with 30+ pts, 10+ reb, 5+ ast, 5+ threes in a playoff game. Historic performance to close out Wolves.

story_log.title: Wemby on facing OKC: 'I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with'
story_log.development: Wemby postgame when asked about facing Thunder: 'Right now I'm not even thinking about it. I'm thinking about recovering. I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with.' Internet loves the exhausted honesty.

story_log.title: Canadiens can close out Sabres in Game 6 at home
story_log.development: Montreal leads series 3-2, can advance to Conference Finals at home tonight. Cole Caufield has 21 goals in 23 Saturday games this season including playoffs, leads NHL.

story_log.title: Cooper Flagg and girlfriend already have people talking about 'Class of 2045' kids
story_log.development: Flagg dating Arianna Robertson (sister of Andre Roberson, also at Duke). Internet already projecting their future kids as basketball prospects: 'Their kids will be 6'1 by 3rd grade.' Wholesome, absurd, very internet.

story_log.title: 2026 NFL schedule release: videos, strength of schedule, primetime games, international slate
story_log.development: Full 2026 NFL schedule released tonight with teams posting creative schedule release videos. Analysis includes strength of schedule breakdowns, primetime slates, bye weeks, road schedules, and strategic advantages/disadvantages across all 32 teams.

story_log.title: Canadiens take 3-2 series lead after wild 6-3 Game 5 win over Sabres
story_log.development: Montreal rallied from 3-1 down to win Game 5 in Buffalo with 5 goals in first 10:15 of game. Ivan Demidov scored first career playoff goal, Jakub Dobes made 32 saves. Canadiens one win from Conference Finals.

story_log.title: Golden Knights close out Ducks in 6 games, advance to Western Conference Finals
story_log.development: Vegas won Game 6 in Anaheim 5-1 to clinch series 4-2 and advance to WCF. Mitch Marner had hat trick and assist. Knights reach Conference Finals for third time in franchise history.

story_log.title: Drake drops THREE albums at midnight: ICEMAN, HABIBTI, MAID OF HONOUR
story_log.development: Drake surprised everyone by releasing three full albums at midnight (titles spell HIM). Featured Future reunion track. Crashed Apple Music and Spotify servers. Included shots at Bronny James and other NBA targets.

story_log.title: Myles Turner reveals Doc Rivers refused to fine Bucks players for tardiness, meetings
story_log.development: Turner on podcast disclosed that Doc Rivers didn't fine anyone for being late to team functions, leading to widespread tardiness and missed meetings. Said Giannis would show up whenever he wanted.

story_log.title: White Sox complete sweep of Royals, MLB-best 5-game win streak
story_log.development: Chicago completes sweep of Kansas City to push win streak to 5 games, best active streak in baseball. Remarkable turnaround for struggling franchise.

story_log.title: Cubs shut out Braves 2-0 behind Ian Happ homer — first XBH in 21 innings
story_log.development: Ian Happ hit 10th homer of year to break Cubs' 21-inning drought without an extra-base hit. Chicago beat Atlanta 2-0, Ben Brown solid on mound.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber crushes 2-run homer in 8th to give Phillies lead over Red Sox
story_log.development: Schwarber broke scoreless tie in eighth inning with 2-run shot. Phillies beat Red Sox 3-1 as Ranger Suarez and Chris Sale dueled.

story_log.title: Dalton Rushing breaks bat over knee, hits himself in helmet with another bat in dugout rage
story_log.development: Dodgers catcher snapped bat over knee in frustration, then accidentally hit himself in helmet while breaking second bat. Later made sure umpire was okay after foul ball.

story_log.title: Will Smith homers in first-ever leadoff appearance for Dodgers
story_log.development: Dodgers catcher batted leadoff for first time in career and immediately went deep against Giants.

story_log.title: Lynx beat Wings 90-86 as Olivia Miles outplays Azzi Fudd in battle of top-2 picks
story_log.development: First WNBA matchup between No. 1 pick Miles (15-6 ast) and No. 2 pick Fudd (8 pts). Minnesota gets win over Dallas.

story_log.title: Bulls hire Magic's Stephen Mervis as SVP, Nets' Acie Law as VP under Bryson Graham
story_log.development: Chicago finalizing deal to bring in Mervis (12 years with Magic) as Senior VP of Basketball Ops and Law (former Thunder/Kings scout) as VP of Player Personnel under new EVP Graham.

story_log.title: Oilers fire head coach Kris Knoblauch despite extension signed in October
story_log.development: Edmonton dismissed Knoblauch who had signed 3-year extension last October that was set to begin in 2026-27 season.

story_log.title: Scottie Scheffler, Jordan Spieth share first-round lead at PGA Championship
story_log.development: Scheffler and Spieth tied for lead after Round 1 at Aronimink. Scheffler's first career major first-round lead. Rory McIlroy melts down with 4 straight bogeys. Bryson struggles. Garrick Higgo penalized 2 strokes for being late to tee time.

story_log.title: Cavs finally win on the road, take 3-2 series lead over Pistons in OT thriller
story_log.development: Cleveland gets their first road win of the playoffs (was 0-5) in overtime Game 5 thriller in Detroit. Harden 30-8-6-3b, Max Strus 20 pts/6 threes. Cade had 39-9-7 in loss. Series shifts back to Cleveland for Game 6.

story_log.title: Avalanche rally from 3-0 down, advance to Western Conference Finals in OT
story_log.development: Colorado trailed 3-0 midway through second period, tied it late in regulation, then Brett Kulak won it in OT. MacKinnon scored in his 6th straight game. Avs reach Conference Finals for first time since winning Cup in 2022.

story_log.title: Dolphins make De'Von Achane third-highest-paid RB with $64M extension
story_log.development: Miami and Achane agreed to 4-year, $64M extension ($68M with incentives), $32M guaranteed. Makes him third-highest-paid RB. Comes days after Jets gave Breece Hall 3-year, $45.5M deal.

story_log.title: Ohtani dominates on mound again while slumping at plate: 7 IP, 8 K, 0 ER
story_log.development: Ohtani struck out 8 in 7 scoreless innings vs Giants, continuing mound dominance. But he's out of lineup again due to slump at plate. His ERA now 0.82, lowest among qualified pitchers.

story_log.title: NBA lands on '3-2-1 lottery' proposal to curb tanking
story_log.development: Adam Silver confirmed on Stephen A. Smith's show that NBA has landed on proposal to present to board of governors later this month to revamp draft lottery.

story_log.title: Braves become first MLB team to 30 wins with comeback over Cubs
story_log.development: Atlanta rallied with 3 runs in 8th inning to beat Cubs 4-1, improving to 30-13, first team to reach 30 wins.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark's first two games: 20/5/7 and 24/4/9 in 2-0 Fever start
story_log.development: Clark followed opening night's 20-5-7 with 24-4-9 tonight. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Magic Johnson was courtside watching.

story_log.title: Rockies' Mickey Moniak hits for the cycle vs Pirates
story_log.development: Moniak went double-triple-homer and then singled to complete cycle. First Rockies cycle since Charlie Blackmon in 2018.

story_log.title: Jacob Misiorowski now leads MLB with 80 strikeouts after 7 more shutout innings
story_log.development: Misiorowski threw 7 shutout innings with more strikeouts, now leads all of MLB with 80 Ks. Dylan Cease is second with 75.

story_log.title: Daulton Varsho hits walk-off grand slam for Blue Jays
story_log.development: Varsho hit walk-off grand slam to give Toronto dramatic win.

story_log.title: Yankees' Max Fried exits start with elbow soreness, will undergo testing
story_log.development: Fried pulled after 3 innings with soreness in pitching elbow. Says he's 'not too worried' but will undergo tests Thursday.

story_log.title: Juan Soto exits game after fouling ball off foot, X-rays negative
story_log.development: Soto fouled ball off right foot early in game, was shaken up, later removed in 7th inning. X-rays came back negative, listed day-to-day.

story_log.title: Rockies OF Jake McCarthy turns first unassisted DP by outfielder since 2015
story_log.development: McCarthy recorded rare unassisted double play from outfield vs Pirates, first by OF since 2015.

story_log.title: NFL announces first Thanksgiving Eve game: Packers at Rams on Netflix
story_log.development: Packers-Rams will be first-ever Thanksgiving Eve NFL game on Wednesday night before Thanksgiving, on Netflix. Part of expanding Netflix NFL package.

story_log.title: Brandon Clarke of the Memphis Grizzlies dies at 29 years old
story_log.development: Clarke, a 7-year veteran forward and 2019 first-round pick, died today at 29 years old.

story_log.title: Wemby's revenge game: 27-17-5-3b as Spurs take 3-2 series lead over Wolves
story_log.development: After ejection in Game 4, Wembanyama explodes for 27 points, 17 rebounds, 5 assists, 3 blocks. Had 16 points in first 6 minutes. Spurs one win from Western Conference Finals for first time since 2017. Dylan Harper 12-10 off bench, Keldon Johnson 21 points. Julius Randle continues to struggle.

story_log.title: Sixers fire Daryl Morey after six seasons, Nick Nurse stays as head coach
story_log.development: Morey and ownership met today in Philadelphia and decided to part ways. Bob Myers will lead search for new president of basketball operations. Nick Nurse continues as head coach into fourth season despite GM being fired.

story_log.title: Paul Skenes flirts with no-hitter, continues historically dominant stretch
story_log.development: Skenes took no-hitter into late innings, finished with 8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 0 BB, 10 SO. Now has 16 IP, 4 H, 0 R, 0 BB, 17 SO in May. Only pitcher with multiple 8+ IP, 7+ SO starts this season. ERA at 1.98 across first 64 career starts.

story_log.title: NFL reveals full international slate: 9 games across 6 countries
story_log.development: All nine international matchups announced: Week 1 Rams/49ers in Australia, Week 3 Ravens/Cowboys in Brazil, three London games, France, Spain, Germany, Mexico. Full schedule releases Thursday.

story_log.title: Cal Raleigh snaps 0-for-38 slump with hits in consecutive at-bats
story_log.development: Raleigh broke out of longest hitless streak of his career and longest by any player this season with single, then hit again. Teammates saved the ball. Prior to game, showered in full uniform to break the slump.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani ends 13-game homer drought with Ice Cube in the booth
story_log.development: Ohtani hit first home run since April 26th moments after Ice Cube entered the Dodgers broadcast booth. Wanted the ball back from fan.

story_log.title: Sabres tie series 2-2 with Tage Thompson bank-shot goal from mid-ice
story_log.development: Buffalo rallied in Game 4 in Montreal. Tage Thompson scored off the boards from mid-ice. Zach Benson gave Sabres third-period lead. Series tied 2-2.

story_log.title: Golden Knights go up 3-2 on Ducks with OT win, can close out series in Anaheim
story_log.development: Pavel Dorofeyev scored in overtime to give Vegas 3-2 series lead. Tomas Hertl scored twice after going 29 games without a goal. Knights can advance in Game 6.

story_log.development: Hall of Famer McGrady takes role with Wagner men's basketball program, leading operations, recruiting and NIL efforts. Son Laymen committed to Wagner last month.

story_log.development: Multiple Week 1 and primetime games officially announced: Chiefs-Broncos Monday Night Week 1, Bills-Lions Thursday Night Week 2 at new Highmark Stadium, Cowboys-Eagles Thanksgiving. Full schedule releases Thursday night.

story_log.title: Thunder sweep Lakers as LeBron faces uncertain future
story_log.development: Thunder completed sweep with Game 4 win in LA. LeBron postgame: 'I don't know what the future holds for me.' First sweep of LeBron in second round. Ajay Mitchell averaged 23-6 in series. Dillon Brooks attended as courtside hatewatch.

story_log.title: Donovan Mitchell's 39-point second half ties series 2-2
story_log.development: Mitchell scored 39 points in second half, tied playoff record for most in a half. Cavs ran 24-0 to start second half. Series tied 2-2 heading back to Detroit.

story_log.title: NBA will not suspend Wembanyama for Game 5 after ejection
story_log.development: NBA announced Wemby will not face suspension after flagrant-2 ejection for elbowing Naz Reid. Timberwolves players and Kendrick Perkins criticized decision. Game 5 tonight in San Antonio.

story_log.title: Cal Raleigh's 0-for-34 is longest hitless streak in Live Ball Era after 40-homer season
story_log.development: Raleigh now 0-for-34, longest hitless streak in Live Ball Era by player following 40-homer season. Currently longest hitless stretch any player has had this season.

story_log.title: MLB and MLBPA begin CBA talks to avoid December lockout
story_log.development: First official collective bargaining talks held today before CBA expires Dec 1. Opening presentations setting up long bargaining road ahead.

story_log.title: René Cárdenas, MLB's first Spanish-language broadcaster, dies at 96
story_log.development: Cárdenas, who called games for Dodgers, Astros and Rangers across decades-long career, died today at 96.

story_log.title: PGA Championship begins at Aronimink with LIV stars under pressure
story_log.development: Second major of 2026 begins at Aronimink. DeChambeau and Rahm need strong showings after poor Masters with LIV Golf crumbling.

story_log.title: Michigan-UConn NCAA title game rematch scheduled for November
story_log.development: Dusty May and Dan Hurley schedule rematch of national championship game for November as both coaches build aggressive non-conference schedules.

story_log.title: Blue Jackets sign Charlie Coyle to 6-year, $36M deal
story_log.development: Columbus signed Coyle to six-year contract through 2031-32 season worth $36 million.

story_log.title: Bucks fully open for business on Giannis trade offers
story_log.development: Shams reports Milwaukee is fully open to trade offers for Giannis Antetokounmpo from NBA Draft Combine.

story_log.title: Wizards win NBA Draft Lottery, get No. 1 pick — Clippers steal Pacers' No. 5 pick in Zubac trade
story_log.development: Draft lottery held today. Wizards won No. 1 overall, Jazz No. 2, Grizzlies No. 3, Bulls No. 4. Pacers' pick jumped to No. 5 but goes to Clippers due to trade protections. First lottery under new anti-tanking rules.

story_log.title: Wemby ejected for elbowing Naz Reid in the jaw — Spurs lose Game 4 without him
story_log.development: Wembanyama received flagrant-2 and first career ejection for elbowing Naz Reid early in 2nd quarter of Game 4. Timberwolves won without facing Wemby, tied series 2-2.

story_log.title: Knicks sweep Sixers 144-114, advance to Eastern Conference Finals
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Knicks completed sweep with Game 4 blowout in Philly. Set playoff record with 18 threes in a half. Deuce McBride 25 points on 7-9 from three. Knicks fans took over arena again. Embiid postgame: 'I don't even know if I'm gonna be here.'

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards dedicates 36-point Game 4 win to late mother on Mother's Day
story_log.development: Edwards dropped 36 points (16 in 4Q) to even series at 2-2. Postgame: 'Today is Mother's Day, I just wanted to win for my mom.' Edwards lost his mother to cancer when he was 14.

story_log.title: Chargers sign David Njoku to 1-year, $8M deal
story_log.development: Njoku left Browns after nine seasons, signed with Chargers on one-year deal worth up to $8M to catch passes from Justin Herbert.

story_log.title: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy shot at concert, in stable condition after surgery
story_log.development: Missouri All-SEC RB Ahmad Hardy was shot at a concert in Mississippi early Sunday morning, underwent surgery, now in stable condition.

story_log.title: Giants host Cowboys in Week 1 Sunday Night Football — Harbaugh's debut
story_log.development: NFL announced Cowboys at Giants on Sept. 13 as first SNF game of 2026 season. Will be John Harbaugh's Giants coaching debut.

story_log.title: Bobby Cox, Hall of Fame Braves manager who won 1995 World Series, dies at 84
story_log.development: Bobby Cox, who managed the Braves to 14 consecutive division titles and the 1995 World Series, died today at 84. Fourth all-time in managerial wins.

story_log.title: Sean Strickland upsets Khamzat Chimaev by split decision to win middleweight title at UFC 328
story_log.development: Strickland won via split decision as massive underdog, handing Chimaev his first career loss. Second huge upset title win for Strickland after beating Adesanya in 2023.

story_log.title: Thunder go up 3-0 on Lakers with 23-point blowout despite +15 FT disparity for LA
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: OKC won Game 3 in LA despite Lakers shooting 25 FTs to Thunder's 10. Ajay Mitchell had 24-10 with 0 turnovers, Lakers one loss from elimination.

story_log.title: Steve Kerr agrees to 2-year extension to remain Warriors coach, stays highest-paid in NBA
story_log.development: Kerr signed new two-year deal after three weeks of negotiations, remains highest-paid coach in NBA. Continues legendary Warriors partnership into 13th season.

story_log.title: Hurricanes complete back-to-back sweeps, first team to start playoffs 8-0 this century
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Carolina swept Flyers in OT of Game 4, becoming first team this century to open playoffs with consecutive sweeps. Jackson Blake scored OT winner.

story_log.title: Guardians trade No. 29 pick for Giants catcher Patrick Bailey
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: No new development, but trade completed officially today. Bailey acquisition gives Cleveland elite defensive catcher.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark scores 28 in Fever loss to Paige Bueckers, Wings in WNBA opener
story_log.development: Clark had 28 points but Fever lost to Wings in season opener. Paige Bueckers led Dallas. Opening night also saw Angel Reese debut for Dream with 11-14 double-double.

story_log.title: James Harden hits 3 straight clutch buckets as Cavs defend home court in Game 2
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Harden hit three consecutive late-game shots to seal Cavs win. Nonchalant demeanor while doing it drew reactions. Cavs remain undefeated at home.

story_log.title: Shea Langeliers leads all catchers in hits and homers through 38 games
story_log.development: A's catcher Langeliers has 50 hits and 11 HRs, leading all catchers. Hitting .340/.391/.626 with 1.017 OPS and 176 wRC+.

story_log.title: Brewers walk off Yankees in extras after umpires deny Murphy's challenge
story_log.development: Milwaukee rallied from behind after umps ruled manager Pat Murphy took too long to challenge a play at second. William Contreras tied it, Jackson Chourio won it with infield single.

story_log.title: Twins mount wild comeback win after Brooks Lee saves game with defensive gem
story_log.development: Twins won in extras after Brooks Lee made game-saving defensive play in 10th. Byron Buxton and Brooks Lee/Kody Clemens delivered hits in 11th.

story_log.title: Wemby's 39-15-5 gem in Game 3 puts Spurs up 2-1 on the Wolves
story_log.development: Wemby dropped 39 points, 15 rebounds, and 5 blocks (13-18 FG, 16 in 4Q) to lead Spurs to Game 3 road win. First player in NBA history with 35/15/5b on 70%+ FG in playoffs. Chris Finch had on-court confrontation with Tony Brothers. Julius Randle disappeared with 12-0-3 on 3-12 FG.

story_log.title: Knicks go up 3-0 behind Brunson, take over Philly arena
story_log.development: Knicks won Game 3 in Philly without OG Anunoby (hamstring). Brunson had 33 points and 9 assists. Landry Shamet gave 15 bench points, Philly bench had 11. Embiid went 8 points on 3-7 shooting in first half then complained about refs. Knicks fans packed arena — might be biggest road takeover in NBA history.

story_log.title: Guardians acquire Gold Glove C Patrick Bailey from Giants
story_log.development: Cleveland traded No. 29 draft pick and LHP Matt Wilkinson for two-time Gold Glove catcher Patrick Bailey. Bailey has struggled offensively but is elite defensively. Giants get $3.27M in slot value.

story_log.title: Jets lock in Breece Hall with 3-year, $45.75M extension
story_log.development: Hall, who was franchise tagged in March, signed 3-year extension worth $45.75M. One of the league's top backs locked in through 2028.

story_log.title: Cubs hit SECOND 10-game win streak of 2026 season
story_log.development: Chicago won 10th straight game today, marking second 10-game streak this season — first MLB team to do that since 1955. Cubs have best record in baseball and 15-0 home streak at Wrigley. Michael Busch saw 37 pitches in 5 plate appearances.

story_log.title: Brewers pitcher Jacob Misiorowski throws 10 pitches at 103+ mph
story_log.development: Misiorowski threw 10 pitches of at least 103 mph and hit 105.3 — highest velocity by any starter since Statcast began in 2008. Also threw 6 shutout innings with 11 strikeouts vs Yankees.

story_log.title: Broncos extend GM George Paton through 2030
story_log.development: Denver signed GM George Paton to five-year extension through 2030. Built roster that reached AFC Championship last season.

story_log.title: Mavs hire Mike Schmitz as GM under Masai Ujiri
story_log.development: Dallas hired former Blazers assistant GM Mike Schmitz to run basketball operations under president Masai Ujiri.

story_log.title: NFL refs ratify 7-year CBA, avoid work stoppage
story_log.development: NFLRA ratified new seven-year CBA with NFL through 2032 season. Vote was 116-4. Eliminates possibility of replacement refs.

story_log.title: Christian McCaffrey and Olivia Culpo expecting second child
story_log.development: 49ers RB and former Miss Universe announced they're expecting second child.

story_log.title: WNBA season tips off with Caitlin Clark's Fever debut
story_log.development: WNBA season opens today with Fever vs Wings. Caitlin Clark in Year 3, Azzi Fudd makes WNBA debut. Toronto Tempo plays first game in franchise history as Canada's first WNBA team. Breanna Stewart had 31-10-3 in Liberty opener.

story_log.title: Bears opponents drew fewest penalty yards in NFL in 2025 season
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics published final 2025 season penalty data showing Bears opponents drew just 678 penalty yards — 400+ fewer than Cowboys and Giants

story_log.title: Thunder go up 2-0 on Lakers with dominant home win
story_log.development: OKC won Game 2 behind SGA and Chet Holmgren, remain perfect at 6-0 in playoffs; Lakers and JJ Redick complain about officiating after game

story_log.title: Pistons take 2-0 series lead as Cade dominates at home
story_log.development: Detroit won Game 2 behind Cade Cunningham's 25-10 and clutch fourth quarter; James Harden continues playoff struggles with more turnovers than baskets

story_log.title: Vikings sign 49ers WR Jauan Jennings to $13M one-year deal
story_log.development: Jennings replaces Jalen Nailor who left for Raiders; will play with Kyler Murray who was his college QB at Tennessee

story_log.title: Cubs win 9th straight to tie Yankees and Braves for best record in MLB
story_log.development: Chicago swept Reds to improve to 26-12, tied with NYY/ATL for best record; PCA celebrates with mop

story_log.title: NCAA votes to expand men's and women's tournaments to 76 teams
story_log.development: Committee unanimously approved expansion starting 2027; first games Tuesday/Wednesday with new bracket format

story_log.title: Taylor Heinicke retires after 11-year NFL career
story_log.development: Journeyman QB who started playoff game for Washington announces retirement

story_log.title: Knicks' OG Anunoby suffers hamstring strain in Game 2 win
story_log.development: Anunoby diagnosed with right hamstring strain, questionable for Game 3; is Knicks second-leading scorer at 21.4 PPG

story_log.title: Hurricanes one win from second consecutive sweep
story_log.development: Carolina takes 3-0 lead over Flyers after Game 3 win; could secure back-to-back sweeps

story_log.title: Rays go 13-1 in last 14 games with dominant pitching
story_log.development: Tampa Bay has allowed just 21 runs in last 14 games, only team under 40 in that span

story_log.title: Mavs Hire Masai Ujiri as Team President After Six-Month Search
story_log.development: Dallas officially hired Ujiri as Team President and Alternate Governor after firing Nico Harrison in November. Ujiri built Raptors' 2019 championship team.

story_log.title: Magic Fire Jamahl Mosley After Blowing 3-1 Lead to Pistons
story_log.development: Orlando dismissed Mosley after 5 seasons following third straight first-round exit. Sources say Paolo frustrated with late-game playcalling.

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards Pushing to Play Game 1 Despite Injury
story_log.development: Edwards listed as questionable, participated significantly in shootaround, pushing medical staff to let him play vs Spurs.

story_log.title: Cowboys Face #4 Toughest Schedule After Playing #3 Easiest in 2025
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics released 2026 schedule rankings. Cowboys have second-biggest difficulty jump league-wide.

story_log.title: What's Next for Anthony Richardson After Colts Decline Fifth-Year Option
story_log.development: Analysis pieces examining Richardson's future after Colts declined option. He hits free agency after 2026 season.

story_log.title: Baseball World Mourns Yankees Radio Icon John Sterling
story_log.development: Tributes continue pouring in day after Sterling's death. Reactions from players, media, fans remembering iconic calls.

story_log.title: Braves Off to Best Start Since 1892 Boston Beaneaters
story_log.development: Atlanta's hot start matches franchise's best since 1892 when they were the Boston Beaneaters.

story_log.title: Giants Call Up Top Prospect Bryce Eldridge After 0-6 Road Trip
story_log.development: San Francisco calling up Eldridge after producing just 2 runs in 3-game Rays series during brutal 0-6 road trip.

story_log.title: Savannah Bananas Pack Kyle Field With 102,000 Fans
story_log.development: Bananas filled Texas A&M football stadium to capacity for game vs Texas Tailgaters. Largest crowd in exhibition baseball history.

story_log.title: NFL 2026 Schedule Strength Rankings Released
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analytics published full 2026 schedule difficulty rankings. Lions easiest, Cardinals hardest.

story_log.title: Cavs Ice Drake and Toronto, Advance on Jarrett Allen's 22-19
story_log.development: Cavs won Game 7 at home. Jarrett Allen dominates with 22 points, 19 rebounds in closeout win.

story_log.title: Pistons Complete 3-1 Comeback, First Series Win in 18 Years
story_log.development: Pistons won Game 7, completed 3-1 comeback. First playoff series win since 2008. Tobias Harris 30 pts, Cade 32 pts.

story_log.title: Jaylen Brown Calls Out Embiid for Flopping, Refs for 'Agenda'
story_log.development: Jaylen Brown went on Twitch stream day after Game 7 loss, accused Embiid of flopping and refs of having agenda.

story_log.title: Yankees Radio Icon John Sterling Dies at 87
story_log.development: John Sterling, Yankees radio voice for 36 seasons, died today.

story_log.title: Colts Decline Anthony Richardson's Fifth-Year Option
story_log.development: Colts declined Richardson's 2027 option. He will hit free agency after 2026 season.

story_log.title: Wild-Avalanche Game 1 Ends 9-6 in 15-Goal Shootout
story_log.development: Game 1 of second round series had 15 combined goals, 10th such playoff game in NHL history.

story_log.title: Paolo Banchero Questions Magic's Championship Ceiling After Collapse
story_log.development: After Magic blew 3-1 lead, Paolo said 'I can't say we're good enough to be in the Finals or Eastern finals.'

story_log.title: Yankees Option Anthony Volpe to Triple-A
story_log.development: Volpe optioned to minors after rehab window closed.

story_log.title: Calais Campbell Returns to Ravens on One-Year Deal
story_log.development: Veteran DE Campbell reuniting with Ravens after playing there 2020-2022.

story_log.title: Fernando Mendoza Working Under Center in Raiders Rookie Camp
story_log.development: Mendoza says he's learned a lot but has long way to go taking snaps under center.
